B1.name: Late group
B1.text: A group of walkers reaches the kerb near the end of the steady green, and some of them start on the flashing green, so they are still on the zebra while the turning cars want to clear.

B2.name: Deadline e-bike
B2.text: A delivery e-bike rider racing a delivery deadline arrives so that they enter the zebra during the flashing green, just as a turning car is about to clear across it.

B3.name: Late runner
B3.text: A runner arrives after the flashing green has started and meets the turning cars that are clearing at the end of the green.

B4.name: Hidden walker
B4.text: A walker steps into the motorcycle's lane while the queue of turning cars hides them from the approaching delivery motorcycle rider.

B5.name: Counterflow
B5.text: People from both directions meet inside the turning car's lane on the zebra while a car waits to pass.

B6.name: Slow last crosser
B6.text: A slow walker starts crossing late in the steady green and is still on the zebra after the green ends, while the turning cars want to clear.

B7.name: Two riders
B7.text: The delivery e-bike is on the zebra as the delivery motorcycle turns through its lane.

B8.name: Open
B8.text: Any admissible scenario in which the turning car's progress costs the people crossing the most: the most waiting, slowing and close passes for them.
